# Expo UI on Android

Captured on the Android 17 (API 37) Pixel 10a emulator with Expo Go 58.0.5
using the T3 device tools. Open `examples/expo-ui` in Expo Go.

- `home` shows the initial controls.
- `changed` shows one Increment tap, Notifications on, Hello entered, and the slider moved to 75.
- `scrolled` starts at the changed state, scrolls to the bottom, and taps Embedded 0.

Compare with `scripts/compare-expo-ui.sh android`.
